title: Estimate recovered from a trace
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$, a trace of estimate records defines a restricted Fourier weight estimate as follows: for a coordinate set $J$ and a frequency set $S\subseteq J$, use the estimate from the first record in the trace whose coordinate set is $J$ and whose frequency prefix is the lift of $S$; if there is no such record, use zero.
